scope: 649 cached feature instances; this is a declared-original-chain-name audit, not a new coordinate/feature recomputation
feature_path: scripts/featurise_benchmark.py calls benchmark.structures.load_antigen before compute_burial and feature extraction
patch_path: benchmark.geometric_predictor.GeometricArm uses the same antigen-only loader before SASA and patch ranking
assembly_path: antigen_assembly removes non-antigen chains before neighbourhood trimming; antigen_only removes all nondeclared chains for the asymmetric-unit fallback
interpretation: Antigen-only coordinates retain the bound-complex conformation; these are not experimentally measured unbound structures. Antibody coordinates are used to define contact labels, not retained intentionally as feature context.
